breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the instruction to set the end slopes to zero was incorrect for a simply supported beam. It explicitly states: 'The slope at the supports is not zero; the condition of zero end slopes does not apply for a simply supported beam under uniform load—this was a misinterpretation.' This successfully corrects the flawed physics in the original prompt, aligning with the ground truth which omits this incorrect condition.
